name: arbab
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs fenced headless Claude Code workers from your interactive session: one git worktree per lane, sandboxed role fences, quota-aware launches, usage-limit auto-resume, and a verify, review, readiness and land pipeline that never runs worker code on your host.
author: Özgür Sağıroğlu (https://github.com/ozgursagiroglu)

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
